name: Oxilorphan
summary: Oxilorphan (INN, USAN) (developmental code name L-BC-2605) is an opioid antagonist of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It acts as a μ-opioid receptor (MOR) antagonist but a κ-opioid receptor (KOR) partial agonist, and has similar effects to naloxone and around the same potency as an MOR antagonist.

pharmacology.text: Oxilorphan (INN, USAN) (developmental code name L-BC-2605) is an opioid antagonist of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It acts as a μ-opioid receptor (MOR) antagonist but a κ-opioid receptor (KOR) partial agonist, and has similar effects to naloxone and around the same potency as an MOR antagonist.

uses.text: Oxilorphan (INN, USAN) (developmental code name L-BC-2605) is an opioid antagonist of the morphinan family that was never marketed. It was trialed for the treatment of opioid addiction, but was not developed commercially. It has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that activate the κ-opioid receptor commonly cause low mood, unease, confusion and hallucinations. It can also bring on withdrawal in people dependent on opioids.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。活化 κ 型鴉片受體的藥物常造成情緒低落、不適感、意識混亂與幻覺。它也可能讓鴉片類藥物依賴者出現戒斷反應。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。活化 κ 型鸦片受体的药物常造成情绪低落、不适感、意识混乱与幻觉。它也可能让鸦片类药物依赖者出现戒断反应。

fact.en: It blocks the μ-opioid receptor but activates the κ receptor, the same split that nalorphine has, and this combination is why such drugs often cause unpleasant mental effects.
fact.zh: 它阻斷 μ 型鴉片受體卻活化 κ 受體，與烯丙嗎啡相同的分工模式；正是這種組合讓這類藥物常造成不愉快的精神作用。
fact.zhHans: 它阻断 μ 型鸦片受体却活化 κ 受体，与烯丙吗啡相同的分工模式；正是这种组合让这类药物常造成不愉快的精神作用。
